notes: Total 60 as published. The objective is posted as 'Quiet Mining Colony/Inpependent Mains Party House' (a joke back-side name) and dested Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation.

The strategy says the deck starts Bespin and 'Quest Quarters' and 'usually Squadron Assignments, Staging Areas, and Insurrection'; no starting Interrupt is named and several Effects start, so starting.interrupt/effect are left empty.

Posted 'Cloud City Quest Chambers' dested Cloud City: Guest Quarters (the strategy's starting 'Quest Quarters'); 'Cloud City Docking Bay' dested Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay), the only Light Cloud City docking bay in the pool.
Bespin: Cloud City is listed twice ('Bespin-Cloud City' and 'Bespin Cloud City'); both rows kept as posted.

Blount' Lieutenant Blount; 'Major Haashn' Major Haash'n; 'Pucumyr Thryss' Pucumir Thryss; 'Orrimarko' Orrimaarko; 'Punch It' Punch It!; 'Staging Area's' Staging Areas; 'Lukes Saber' Luke's Lightsaber.
